							}
						}
					}
				}
				unlock_decision_tooltip = NAM_escort_order
				custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_escort_order_unlock_tt
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					hidden_trigger = {
						NOT = {
							AND = {
								has_completed_focus = NAM_naval_construction
								has_completed_focus = NAM_active_squadron
							}
						}
					}
				}
				unlock_decision_tooltip = NAM_submarine_order
				custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_submarine_order_unlock_tt
			}
			NAM_pw_enact_sea_training = yes
			688 = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_owned_by = ROOT
						is_controlled_by = ROOT
						free_building_slots = { building = dockyard size > 0 include_locked = yes }
					}
					add_extra_state_shared_building_slots = 1
					add_building_construction = {
						type = dockyard
						level = 1
						instant_build = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add_equipment_to_stockpile = {
				type = convoy
				amount = 10
				producer = NAM
			}
			set_technology = { ADISCORD_tech_destroyer_hull_2155 = 1 }
			set_technology = { ADISCORD_tech_submarine_hull_2155 = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						any_owned_state = {
							is_controlled_by = ROOT
							naval_facility > 0
						}
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						owns_state = 688
						controls_state = 688
						688 = { free_building_slots = { building = naval_facility size > 0 province = 689 } }
					}
					688 = {
						add_building_construction = {
							type = naval_facility
							province = 689
							level = 1
							instant_build = yes
						}
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						owns_state = 700
						controls_state = 700
						controls_province = 16716
						700 = { free_building_slots = { building = naval_facility size > 0 province = 16716 } }
					}
					700 = {
						add_building_construction = {
							type = naval_facility
							province = 16716
							level = 1
							instant_build = yes
						}
					}
				}
				else = {
					custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_barge_no_facility_tt
				}
			}
			generate_scientist_character = {
				skills = {
					specialization_naval = 2
				}
			}
			add_breakthrough_points = {
				specialization = specialization_naval
				value = 1
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_barge_project_tt
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_svetlogorsk_shipyards_reward_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				create_equipment_variant = {
					name = "NAM_auxiliary_patrol_design"
					type = ADISCORD_coastal_patrol_ship_1
				}
				# The pre-war tree already created these designs when both of its
				# focuses were taken; the order then stays with that tree.

						allow_without_tech = yes
					}
				}
				if = {

						NOT = {
							AND = {
								has_completed_focus = NAM_naval_construction
								has_completed_focus = NAM_active_squadron
							}
						}
					}
					create_equipment_variant = {
						name = "ADISCORD_submarine_2155"
						type = ADISCORD_submarine_2155
						allow_without_tech = yes
					}
				}
				# The dock brings its own shared slot, so a slot that was free before
				# delivery is still free here; the fallback pays when the harbour is
				# lost or full.
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {

								is_owned_by = ROOT
								is_controlled_by = ROOT
								free_building_slots = { building = dockyard size > 0 include_locked = yes }
							}
						}
					}
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = 450 }
					NAM_add_treasury = yes
				}
				country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.303 days = 16 }
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 5
		}

					add_building_construction = {
						type = infrastructure
						level = 1
						instant_build = yes
					}
				}
			}
			690 = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_owned_by = ROOT
						is_controlled_by = ROOT
						infrastructure < 5
					}
					add_building_construction = {
						type = infrastructure
						level = 1
						instant_build = yes
					}
				}
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_depot_station_committees_reward_tt
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_grp_depot_station_committees_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				# Each district not held at delivery, or already at full
				# infrastructure, pays its share to the treasury instead.
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							689 = {
								is_owned_by = ROOT
								is_controlled_by = ROOT
								infrastructure < 5
							}
						}
					}
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = 150 }
					NAM_add_treasury = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							690 = {
								is_owned_by = ROOT
								is_controlled_by = ROOT
								infrastructure < 5
							}
						}
					}
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = 150 }
					NAM_add_treasury = yes
				}
				NAM_depot_raise_front_street = yes
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_depot_push_delta value = -12 }
				NAM_depot_push_target = yes
				add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_dist_support value = 8 }
				add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_trade_support value = -5 }

				amount = 120
				producer = NAM
			}

			67 = {

						type = infrastructure
						level = 1
						instant_build = yes
					}

			}

					limit = {
						is_owned_by = ROOT
						is_controlled_by = ROOT
						infrastructure < 5
					}

						type = infrastructure

				NAM_refresh_garrison = yes
				# The executive side recalls district garrisons to the border; the

					add_manpower = 4000
				}
				else = {
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = 300 }
					NAM_add_treasury = yes
				}
				# A road level that cannot be built (lost state or the level-5 cap)
				# is paid in treasury.
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							67 = {
								is_owned_by = ROOT
								is_controlled_by = ROOT
								infrastructure < 5
							}
						}
					}
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = 150 }
					NAM_add_treasury = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							688 = {
								is_owned_by = ROOT
								is_controlled_by = ROOT
								infrastructure < 5
							}
						}
					}
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = 150 }
					NAM_add_treasury = yes
				}
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 5

		id = NAM_prag_south_bills

					has_global_flag = ADISCORD_south_final_started
				}
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = ADISCORD_south_final_resolved_focus_condition_tt
					has_global_flag = ADISCORD_south_final_resolved
				}
			}
		}
		prerequisite = {

		}
		mutually_exclusive = { focus = NAM_prag_settlement_agreements }

			}

			}
		}
		cancel_if_invalid = yes
		continue_if_invalid = no
		completion_reward = {
			add_political_power = 60
			if = {
				limit = {
					hidden_trigger = { ADISCORD_south_contest_open = yes }
				}
				custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_prag_south_bills_south_tt
				custom_effect_tooltip = ADISCORD_south_power_gain_2_tt
				if = {
					limit = {
						hidden_trigger = { has_global_flag = ADISCORD_south_spheres_agreed }
					}
					custom_effect_tooltip = ADISCORD_south_spheres_note_tt
				}
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_prag_south_bills_reward_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				if = {
					limit = { ADISCORD_south_contest_open = yes }
					NAM_prag_collect_contest_countries = yes
					if = {
						limit = {
							any_of_scopes = {
								array = NAM_prag_contest_countries
								has_country_flag = ADISCORD_south_indebted_to_SHL
							}
						}
						for_each_scope_loop = {
							array = NAM_prag_contest_countries
							if = {
								limit = { has_country_flag = ADISCORD_south_indebted_to_SHL }
								ADISCORD_south_redeem_shl_debt = yes
								set_temp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_south_push_delta value = 12 }
								ADISCORD_south_push_influence_north = yes
								set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_prag_south_bills_target days = 60 }
							}
						}
					}
					else = {
						for_each_scope_loop = {
							array = NAM_prag_contest_countries
							if = {
								limit = {
									check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_south_coalition_influence value = 1 compare = less_than }
								}
								set_temp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_south_push_delta value = 6 }
								ADISCORD_south_push_influence_north = yes
								set_country_flag = { flag = NAM_prag_south_bills_target days = 60 }
							}
						}
					}
					set_temp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_south_power_delta value = 2 }
					ADISCORD_south_add_influence_power = yes
					SHL = {
						set_temp_variable = { var = ADISCORD_south_power_delta value = -1 }
						ADISCORD_south_add_influence_power = yes
					}
				}
				add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_trade_support value = 8 }
				add_to_variable = { var = NAM_grp_oil_support value = -5 }
				NAM_groups_refresh = yes
				country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.355 days = 2 }
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = { base = 5 }

			# because the state is not held or its roads are full, pays 150.

				limit = {
					owns_state = 690
					controls_state = 690
					690 = { infrastructure < 4 }
				}
				690 = {
					add_building_construction = {
						type = infrastructure
						level = 2
						instant_build = yes
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					owns_state = 690
					controls_state = 690
					690 = { infrastructure < 5 }
				}
				690 = {
					add_building_construction = {
						type = infrastructure
						level = 1
						instant_build = yes
					}
				}
				hidden_effect = {
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = 150 }
					NAM_add_treasury = yes
				}
			}
			else = {
				hidden_effect = {
					set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = 300 }
					NAM_add_treasury = yes
				}
			}
			if = {

			}

			# One payment of 100 per contract holder now, at least 100. The
			# doubled cycle income is read by ADISCORD_south_contest_cycle
			# while this focus is completed.
			hidden_effect = {
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_prag_contract_holders value = 0 }
				if = {
					limit = { ADISCORD_south_contest_open = yes }
					NAM_prag_collect_contest_countries = yes
					for_each_scope_loop = {
						array = NAM_prag_contest_countries
						if = {
							limit = {
								check_variable = { var = ADISCORD_south_tool_kind value = 2 compare = equals }
							}
							add_to_temp_variable = { var = NAM_prag_contract_holders value = 1 }
						}
					}
				}
				clamp_temp_variable = { var = NAM_prag_contract_holders min = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = NAM_prag_contract_holders }
				multiply_temp_variable = { var = NAM_treasury_amount value = 100 }
				NAM_add_treasury = yes
				country_event = { id = ADISCORD_nam_story.382 days = 2 }
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = { base = 20 }
	}

				add_intel = {
					target = event_target:ADISCORD_vorkerland_nation

				}

				custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_veyran_plan_sappers_tt

					producer = NAM
				}

					amount = 250
					producer = NAM

			}
			else = {
				custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_veyran_counterplan_preview_tt
			}
			custom_effect_tooltip = NAM_veyran_invasion_tt
			hidden_effect = { NAM_veyran_start_invasion = yes }
		}
